## "push_to_specify"

**Data type:**  
Boolean

**Value:**  
True, False - default is False.

**Description of metadata field:**  
Not all assets will be pushed to Specify. Some are not needed in specify and for others there could be issues found during processing. Defaults to "false".

**Populated by whom and when:**  
Ingestion server when metadata is created. 

**Updated where and when:**  
Integration server at the end of pipeline processes. Other users as needed.

**Generated by:**  
Ingestion server.

**Maps to in ARS:**  
push_to_specify

**Maps to in Specify:**  
None

**Notes and issues:**  
None
